info.title: Fleetio Universal API
info.description: Fleetio fleet management API for vehicles, maintenance, fuel, meter tracking, vendors, and contacts.

post.description: Creates a new contact in Fleetio.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

birthDate.description: This Contact's birth date. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

groupHierarchy.description: If this Contact belongs to a [Group](/docs/api/groups), this will be a pipe delimited string representing the Group hierarchy. Each Group in the list is the parent of the `Groups` which follow.

otherPhoneNumber.description: Any other phone number for this Contact.

streetAddress.description: The street address of this Contact.

streetAddressLine2.description: The second line of this Contact's street address.

city.description: The city of this Contact's address.

region.description: The region, state, province, or territory of this Contact's address.

postalCode.description: The postal code for this Contact's address.

country.description: The country where this Contact resides.

employeeNumber.description: This Contact's employee number. Must be unique.

startDate.description: The date at which this Contact started, or is expected to start. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

leaveDate.description: The date at which this Contact left, or is expected to leave. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

vehicleOperator.description: Whether this Contact is a Vehicle Operator.

licenseNumber.description: The license number of this Contact.

licenseClass.description: The class of this Contact's license.

licenseState.description: The state, province, region, or territory of this Contact's license.

hourlyLaborRate.description: The hourly labor rate for this Contact.

customFields.description: *Full details on working with Custom Fields [here](/docs/overview/custom-fields).

licenseExpiration.description: The date and time at which this Contact's license expires. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

employee.description: Whether this Contact is an Employee.

technician.description: Whether this Contact is a Technician.

userAccess.description: Whether this Contact has User Access. This must be set to true if using `account_membership_attributes`.

accountMembershipAttributes.description: These attributes require an Organization Token or Partner Token to be present in the request. Any role or record set attributes will be ignored if `user_type` is `admin`. `admin_role_attributes` will be ignored if `user_type` is not  `admin`.

post.description: Creates a new fuel entry in Fleetio.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

meterEntryAttributes.value.description: The actual number on the vehicle's primary meter. Use the current odometer or meter reading for the associated vehicle.

date.description: We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

meterEntryAttributes.void.description: Set this to true only if Fleetio rejects the meter value as too high or too low and you intentionally want to bypass that validation.

usGallons.description: The fuel volume amount in US gallons. This field will _only_ be used if the [Vehicle](/docs/api/vehicles) is [configured to use US gallons](https://help.fleetio.com/s/article/Fuel-Settings#vehicle-settings), otherwise it will be ignored.

meterEntryAttributes.description: Each Fuel Entry requires an associated [Meter Entry](/docs/api/meter-entries)

vendorId.description: The Fleetio `id` of the [Vendor](/docs/api/vendors) associated with this Fuel Entry.

fuelTypeId.description: The Fleetio `id` of the [Fuel Type](/docs/api/fuel-types) associated with this Fuel Entry.

ukGallons.description: The fuel volume amount in UK gallons. This field will _only_ be used if the [Vehicle](/docs/api/vehicles) is [configured to use UK gallons](https://help.fleetio.com/s/article/Fuel-Settings#vehicle-settings), otherwise it will be ignored.

liters.description: The fuel volume amount in liters. This field will be used if the [Vehicle](/docs/api/vehicles) is [configured to use liters](https://help.fleetio.com/s/article/Fuel-Settings#vehicle-settings).

pricePerVolumeUnit.description: The unit price for the Vehicle's [configured volume unit](https://help.fleetio.com/s/article/Fuel-Settings#vehicle-settings).

reference.description: A reference number or identifier for this Fuel Entry. This field is often used to store a receipt number or other unique identifier.

partial.description: Indicates whether this Fuel Entry is a partial fill-up. Partial fill-ups are used to record Fuel Entries that are not full fill-ups. This field is `false` if not provided.

personal.description: Indicates whether this Fuel Entry is personal. Personal Fuel Entries are used to record fuel purchases that are not associated with a specific Vehicle or Equipment. This field is `false` if not provided.

customFields.description: *Full details on working with Custom Fields [here](/docs/overview/custom-fields).

documentsAttributes[].description: An array of one or more document objects to add to the record. Follow our [Attaching Documents and Images](/docs/overview/attaching-documents-and-images) guide to upload to our third party storage provider in order to obtain `file_url`.

imagesAttributes[].description: An array of one or more image objects to add to the record. Follow our [Attaching Documents and Images](/docs/overview/attaching-documents-and-images) guide to upload to our third party storage provider in order to obtain `file_url`.

post.description: Creates a new issue in Fleetio.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

assetId.description: The ID of the asset associated with the Issue.

assetType.description: The type of the asset associated with the Issue.

summary.description: A short summary of the Issue.

reportedAt.description: The date and time this Issue is reported. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

description.description: A longer description of the Issue.

reportedById.description: The id of the `Contact` who reported this Issue.

issuePriorityId.description: The id of the associated `IssuePriority` for this Issue.

number.description: A unique identifier for the Issue.

dueDate.description: The date on which this Issue should be resolved by. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

dueMeterValue.description: The meter value at which this Issue should be resolved by.

dueSecondaryMeterValue.description: The secondary meter value at which this Issue should be resolved by.

faultId.description: The id of the `Fault` associated with this Issue.

customFields.description: *Full details on working with Custom Fields [here](/docs/overview/custom-fields).

meterEntryAttributes.description: An Issue may be associated with a [Meter Entry](/docs/api/meter-entries).

secondaryMeterEntryAttributes.description: An Issue may be associated with a secondary [Meter Entry](/docs/api/meter-entries).

documentsAttributes[].description: An array of one or more document objects to add to the record. Follow our [Attaching Documents and Images](/docs/overview/attaching-documents-and-images) guide to upload to our third party storage provider in order to obtain `file_url`.

imagesAttributes[].description: An array of one or more image objects to add to the record. Follow our [Attaching Documents and Images](/docs/overview/attaching-documents-and-images) guide to upload to our third party storage provider in order to obtain `file_url`.

assignedContactIds[].description: An array of ids of assigned `Contacts` related to the Issue.

post.description: Creates a new meter entry in Fleetio.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

value.description: The value of the meter. The unit can be configured at the `Account` level, or overridden at the `Vehicle` level.

date.description: Meter Entries must follow the correct sequence, incrementing in value by date. For each entry, Fleetio validates to ensure that the value falls between any entries logged before and/or after. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

void.description: Whether to mark this Meter Entry void or not.  See [Voiding Meter Entries](https://help.fleetio.com/s/article/Meter-Entry-Mark-As-Void-Unmark-As-Void).

meterType.description: If this is a secondary meter reading, use this field.  If the vehicle's secondary meter is disabled, secondary meter values will be hidden in the web and mobile views until enabled.

post.description: Creates a new service entry in Fleetio.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

completedAt.description: The date and time at which the Service Entry was completed. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

meterEntryAttributes.value.description: The actual number on the vehicle's primary meter. Use the current odometer or meter reading for the associated vehicle.

meterEntryAttributes.void.description: Set this to true only if Fleetio rejects the meter value as too high or too low and you intentionally want to bypass that validation.

meterEntryAttributes.description: A Service Entry may be associated with a [Meter Entry](/docs/api/meter-entries)

startedAt.description: The date and time at which the Service Entry was started. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

vehicleVin.description: The VIN of the `Vehicle` associated with this Service Entry.

reference.description: A reference number for this Service Entry.

labelList.description: A comma separated list of tags associated with this record. The only delimiter allowed is a comma (`,`). Please remove any commas from your labels before saving the record.

generalNotes.description: Any general notes about this Service Entry.

customFields.description: *Full details on working with Custom Fields [here](/docs/overview/custom-fields).

secondaryMeterEntryAttributes.description: A Service Entry may also be associated with a secondary [Meter Entry](/docs/api/meter-entries)

issueIds[].description: The IDs of any Issues associated with this Service Entry.

serviceTaskIds[].description: The IDs of any Service Tasks associated with this Service Entry.

documentsAttributes[].description: An array of one or more document objects to add to the record. Follow our [Attaching Documents and Images](/docs/overview/attaching-documents-and-images) guide to upload to our third party storage provider in order to obtain `file_url`.

imagesAttributes[].description: An array of one or more image objects to add to the record. Follow our [Attaching Documents and Images](/docs/overview/attaching-documents-and-images) guide to upload to our third party storage provider in order to obtain `file_url`.

laborSubtotal.description: The total cost of labor for this Service Entry. This is calculated by summing the `labor_cost` of each `Service Entry Line Item`.

partsSubtotal.description: The total cost of `Parts` for this Service Entry. This is calculated by summing the `parts_cost` of each `Service Entry Line Item`.

subtotal.description: The subtotal amount of this Service Entry before any discounts or taxes. This is calculated by summing the `subtotal` of each `Service Entry Line Item`.

discount.description: The total discount amount for this Service Entry.

discountPercentage.description: The total discount percentage for this Service Entry.

discountType.description: The type of discount applied to this record.

tax1.description: The first tax amount for this Service Entry.

tax1Percentage.description: The first tax percentage for this Service Entry.

tax1Type.description: The type of tax to apply to this record.

tax2.description: The second tax amount for this Service Entry.

tax2Percentage.description: The second tax percentage for this Service Entry.

tax2Type.description: The type of tax to apply to this record.

totalAmount.description: The grand total of this Service Entry.

post.description: Creates a new vehicle in Fleetio.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

name.description: A name to assign to this Vehicle. Must be unique.

primaryMeterUnit.description: The measurement unit used for the Vehicle's primary, or secondary (if applicable), meter.

vehicleStatusId.description: The ID of the `Vehicle Status` for this Vehicle.

vehicleTypeId.description: The ID of the `Vehicle Type` for this Vehicle.

fuelTypeId.description: The ID of the `Fuel Type` associated with this Vehicle.

groupId.description: The id of the `Group` for the vehicle

groupHierarchy.description: A pipe delimited group hierarchy. Ex: "Level 1|Level 2|Level 3". Where Level 1 is the parent of Level 2, and 2 is the parent of 3. Any missing nodes in the hierarchy will be created.

labelIds[].description: The `label_id`(s) of any Labels to assign to this Vehicle. If you wish to keep any existing Labels, those IDs must be included in this array as well.

licensePlate.description: The license plate number of this Vehicle.

make.description: The name of this Vehicle's manufacturer.

model.description: The name of the model of this Vehicle.

registrationExpirationMonth.description: The month in which this Vehicle's registration expires.

registrationState.description: The state, province, or territory in which this Vehicle is registered.

secondaryMeter.description: Indicates whether or not this Vehicle has a secondary meter.

secondaryMeterUnit.description: The measurement unit used for the Vehicle's primary, or secondary (if applicable), meter.

trim.description: The trim level of this Vehicle.

vin.description: The Vehicle Identification Number of this Vehicle. Must be unique.

linkedVehicleIds[].description: The `vehicle_id`(s) of any Vehicles to link to this Vehicle.

vehicleStatusName.description: The name of the `Vehicle Status` associated with this Vehicle.

vehicleTypeName.description: The name of the `Vehicle Type` associated with this Vehicle.

inServiceDate.description: The date on which this Vehicle was put into service. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

inServiceMeterValue.description: The meter value at which this Vehicle was put into service.

estimatedServiceMonths.description: The estimated number of months this Vehicle will be in service.

estimatedReplacementMileage.description: The estimated number of miles before which this Vehicle will be replaced.

estimatedResalePrice.description: The estimated resale price of this Vehicle.

outOfServiceDate.description: The date on which this Vehicle was or will be retired. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

outOfServiceMeterValue.description: The meter value at which this Vehicle was or will be retired.

customFields.description: *Full details on working with Custom Fields [here](/docs/overview/custom-fields).

post.description: Creates a new vendor in Fleetio.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

name.description: The name of the Vendor. Must be unique.

contactEmail.description: The email address of the contact person for the Vendor.

contactName.description: The name of the contact person for the Vendor.

contactPhone.description: The phone number of the contact person for the Vendor.

externalId.description: An external ID for the Vendor. Must be unique.

phone.description: The phone number of the Vendor.

postalCode.description: The postal code or ZIP code of the Vendor.

region.description: The region, state, province, or territory of the Vendor.

streetAddress.description: The street address of the Vendor.

streetAddressLine2.description: The second line of the street address of the Vendor.

fuel.description: Indicates whether the Vendor provides fuel. Will be able to be listed on `Fuel Entries`.

service.description: Indicates whether the Vendor provides service. This Vendor will be able to be listed on `Service Entries` and `Work Orders`.

parts.description: Indicates whether the Vendor provides parts. This Vendor will be able to be listed on `Parts` and `Purchase Orders`.

vehicle.description: Indicates whether the Vendor provides vehicles. This Vendor will be able to be listed on `Acquisitions` and `Vehicles`.

customFields.description: *Full details on working with Custom Fields [here](/docs/overview/custom-fields).

post.description: Creates a new work order in Fleetio.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

issuedAt.description: The date and time at which this Work Order was issued. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

startedAt.description: The date and time at which this Work Order was started. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

completedAt.description: The date and time at which this Work Order was completed. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

invoiceNumber.description: The number of the `Invoice` associated with this Work Order.

vendorName.description: The name of the `Vendor` associated with this Work Order.

vehicleName.description: The name of the `Vehicle` associated with this Work Order.

discountType.description: The type of discount applied to this Work Order.

discount.description: The discount amount in decimal currency units applied to this Work Order.

discountPercentage.description: The percentage of the discount applied to this Work Order. Used if `discount_type` is set to `percentage`.

partsMarkupPercentage.description: The percentage of the parts markup applied to this Work Order. Used if `parts_markup_type` is set to `percentage`.  Note: Parts markup fields are only writiable for Premium tier Fleetio Plan.

partsMarkupType.description: The type of parts markup to apply to this record.  Note: Parts markup fields are only writiable for Premium tier Fleetio Plan.

partsMarkup.description: The amount of the parts markup applied to this Work Order. Used if `parts_markup_type` is set to `fixed`.  Note: Parts markup fields are only writiable for Premium tier Fleetio Plan.

laborMarkupPercentage.description: The percentage of the labor markup applied to this Work Order. Used if `labor_markup_type` is set to `percentage`.  Note: Labor markup fields are only writiable for Premium tier Fleetio Plan.

laborMarkupType.description: The type of labor markup to apply to this record.  Note: Labor markup fields are only writiable for Premium tier Fleetio Plan.

laborMarkup.description: The amount of the labor markup applied to this Work Order. Used if `labor_markup_type` is set to `fixed`.  Note: Labor markup fields are only writiable for Premium tier Fleetio Plan.

tax1Percentage.description: The percentage of the first tax applied to this Work Order. Used if `tax_1_type` is set to `percentage`.

tax1Type.description: The type of tax to apply to this record.

tax1.description: The amount of the first tax applied to this Work Order. Used if `tax_1_type` is set to `amount`.

tax2Percentage.description: The percentage of the second tax applied to this Work Order. Used if `tax_2_type` is set to `percentage`.

tax2Type.description: The type of tax to apply to this record.

tax2.description: The amount of the second tax applied to this Work Order. Used if `tax_2_type` is set to `amount`.

labelList.description: A comma separated list of tags associated with this record. The only delimiter allowed is a comma (`,`). Please remove any commas from your labels before saving the record.

purchaseOrderNumber.description: The number of the `Purchase Order` associated with this Work Order.

description.description: A description of this Work Order.

number.description: The number to be applied to this Work Order. Must be unique.

meterEntryAttributes.description: A Work Order may also be associated with a [Meter Entry](/docs/api/meter-entries).

secondaryMeterEntryAttributes.description: A Work Order may also be associated with a secondary [Meter Entry](/docs/api/meter-entries).

startingMeterEntryAttributes.description: The meter reading at the start of this Work Order.

endingMeterEntryAttributes.description: The meter reading at the end of this Work Order.

startingSecondaryMeterEntryAttributes.description: The secondary meter reading at the start of this Work Order.

endingSecondaryMeterEntryAttributes.description: The secondary meter reading at the end of this Work Order.

customFields.description: *Full details on working with Custom Fields [here](/docs/overview/custom-fields).

endingMeterSameAsStart.description: Use start meter for completion meter?

scheduledAt.description: The date and time at which this Work Order is scheduled. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

expectedCompletedAt.description: The date and time at which this Work Order is expected to be completed. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

commentsAttributes[].description: A list of `Comments` to be added to this Work Order.

workOrderLineItemsAttributes[].description: A list of `Work Order Line Items` to be added to this Work Order.

workOrderSubLineItemsAttributes[].description: A list of `Work Order Sub Line Items` to be added to this Work Order.

issueIds[].description: A list of `Issues` to be added to this Work Order.

labelIds[].description: A list of `Labels` to be added to this Work Order.

documentsAttributes[].description: An array of one or more document objects to add to the record. Follow our [Attaching Documents and Images](/docs/overview/attaching-documents-and-images) guide to upload to our third party storage provider in order to obtain `file_url`.

imagesAttributes[].description: An array of one or more image objects to add to the record. Follow our [Attaching Documents and Images](/docs/overview/attaching-documents-and-images) guide to upload to our third party storage provider in order to obtain `file_url`.

put.description: Updates an existing contact in Fleetio.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

id.description: The id of the relevant record

birthDate.description: This Contact's birth date. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

groupHierarchy.description: If this Contact belongs to a [Group](/docs/api/groups), this will be a pipe delimited string representing the Group hierarchy. Each Group in the list is the parent of the `Groups` which follow.

otherPhoneNumber.description: Any other phone number for this Contact.

streetAddress.description: The street address of this Contact.

streetAddressLine2.description: The second line of this Contact's street address.

city.description: The city of this Contact's address.

region.description: The region, state, province, or territory of this Contact's address.

postalCode.description: The postal code for this Contact's address.

country.description: The country where this Contact resides.

employeeNumber.description: This Contact's employee number. Must be unique.

startDate.description: The date at which this Contact started, or is expected to start. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

leaveDate.description: The date at which this Contact left, or is expected to leave. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

vehicleOperator.description: Whether this Contact is a Vehicle Operator.

licenseNumber.description: The license number of this Contact.

licenseClass.description: The class of this Contact's license.

licenseState.description: The state, province, region, or territory of this Contact's license.

hourlyLaborRate.description: The hourly labor rate for this Contact.

customFields.description: *Full details on working with Custom Fields [here](/docs/overview/custom-fields).

licenseExpiration.description: The date and time at which this Contact's license expires. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

employee.description: Whether this Contact is an Employee.

technician.description: Whether this Contact is a Technician.

userAccess.description: Whether this Contact has User Access. This must be set to true if using `account_membership_attributes`.

accountMembershipAttributes.description: These attributes require an Organization Token or Partner Token to be present in the request. Any role or record set attributes will be ignored if `user_type` is `admin`. `admin_role_attributes` will be ignored if `user_type` is not  `admin`.

put.description: Updates an existing fuel entry in Fleetio.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

id.description: The id of the relevant record

vendorId.description: The Fleetio `id` of the [Vendor](/docs/api/vendors) associated with this Fuel Entry.

fuelTypeId.description: The Fleetio `id` of the [Fuel Type](/docs/api/fuel-types) associated with this Fuel Entry.

date.description: We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

usGallons.description: The fuel volume amount in US gallons. This field will _only_ be used if the [Vehicle](/docs/api/vehicles) is [configured to use US gallons](https://help.fleetio.com/s/article/Fuel-Settings#vehicle-settings), otherwise it will be ignored.

ukGallons.description: The fuel volume amount in UK gallons. This field will _only_ be used if the [Vehicle](/docs/api/vehicles) is [configured to use UK gallons](https://help.fleetio.com/s/article/Fuel-Settings#vehicle-settings), otherwise it will be ignored.

liters.description: The fuel volume amount in liters. This field will be used if the [Vehicle](/docs/api/vehicles) is [configured to use liters](https://help.fleetio.com/s/article/Fuel-Settings#vehicle-settings).

pricePerVolumeUnit.description: The unit price for the Vehicle's [configured volume unit](https://help.fleetio.com/s/article/Fuel-Settings#vehicle-settings).

meterEntryAttributes.description: Each Fuel Entry requires an associated [Meter Entry](/docs/api/meter-entries)

reference.description: A reference number or identifier for this Fuel Entry. This field is often used to store a receipt number or other unique identifier.

partial.description: Indicates whether this Fuel Entry is a partial fill-up. Partial fill-ups are used to record Fuel Entries that are not full fill-ups. This field is `false` if not provided.

personal.description: Indicates whether this Fuel Entry is personal. Personal Fuel Entries are used to record fuel purchases that are not associated with a specific Vehicle or Equipment. This field is `false` if not provided.

customFields.description: *Full details on working with Custom Fields [here](/docs/overview/custom-fields).

documentsAttributes.description: An array of one or more document objects to add to the record. Follow our [Attaching Documents and Images](/docs/overview/attaching-documents-and-images) guide to upload to our third party storage provider in order to obtain `file_url`.

imagesAttributes.description: An array of one or more image objects to add to the record. Follow our [Attaching Documents and Images](/docs/overview/attaching-documents-and-images) guide to upload to our third party storage provider in order to obtain `file_url`.

put.description: Updates an existing issue in Fleetio.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

id.description: The id of the relevant record

assetId.description: The ID of the asset associated with the Issue.

assetType.description: The type of the asset associated with the Issue.

summary.description: A short summary of the Issue.

description.description: A longer description of the Issue.

reportedById.description: The id of the `Contact` who reported this Issue.

reportedAt.description: The date and time this Issue is reported. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

issuePriorityId.description: The id of the associated `IssuePriority` for this Issue.

number.description: A unique identifier for the Issue.

dueDate.description: The date on which this Issue should be resolved by. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

dueMeterValue.description: The meter value at which this Issue should be resolved by.

dueSecondaryMeterValue.description: The secondary meter value at which this Issue should be resolved by.

faultId.description: The id of the `Fault` associated with this Issue.

customFields.description: *Full details on working with Custom Fields [here](/docs/overview/custom-fields).

meterEntryAttributes.description: An Issue may be associated with a [Meter Entry](/docs/api/meter-entries).

secondaryMeterEntryAttributes.description: An Issue may be associated with a secondary [Meter Entry](/docs/api/meter-entries).

documentsAttributes.description: An array of one or more document objects to add to the record. Follow our [Attaching Documents and Images](/docs/overview/attaching-documents-and-images) guide to upload to our third party storage provider in order to obtain `file_url`.

imagesAttributes.description: An array of one or more image objects to add to the record. Follow our [Attaching Documents and Images](/docs/overview/attaching-documents-and-images) guide to upload to our third party storage provider in order to obtain `file_url`.

assignedContactIds.description: An array of ids of assigned `Contacts` related to the Issue.

put.description: Updates an existing service entry in Fleetio.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

id.description: The id of the relevant record

completedAt.description: The date and time at which the Service Entry was completed. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

startedAt.description: The date and time at which the Service Entry was started. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

vehicleVin.description: The VIN of the `Vehicle` associated with this Service Entry.

reference.description: A reference number for this Service Entry.

labelList.description: A comma separated list of tags associated with this record. The only delimiter allowed is a comma (`,`). Please remove any commas from your labels before saving the record.

generalNotes.description: Any general notes about this Service Entry.

customFields.description: *Full details on working with Custom Fields [here](/docs/overview/custom-fields).

meterEntryAttributes.description: A Service Entry may be associated with a [Meter Entry](/docs/api/meter-entries)

secondaryMeterEntryAttributes.description: A Service Entry may also be associated with a secondary [Meter Entry](/docs/api/meter-entries)

issueIds.description: The IDs of any Issues associated with this Service Entry.

serviceTaskIds.description: The IDs of any Service Tasks associated with this Service Entry.

documentsAttributes.description: An array of one or more document objects to add to the record. Follow our [Attaching Documents and Images](/docs/overview/attaching-documents-and-images) guide to upload to our third party storage provider in order to obtain `file_url`.

imagesAttributes.description: An array of one or more image objects to add to the record. Follow our [Attaching Documents and Images](/docs/overview/attaching-documents-and-images) guide to upload to our third party storage provider in order to obtain `file_url`.

laborSubtotal.description: The total cost of labor for this Service Entry. This is calculated by summing the `labor_cost` of each `Service Entry Line Item`.

partsSubtotal.description: The total cost of `Parts` for this Service Entry. This is calculated by summing the `parts_cost` of each `Service Entry Line Item`.

subtotal.description: The subtotal amount of this Service Entry before any discounts or taxes. This is calculated by summing the `subtotal` of each `Service Entry Line Item`.

discount.description: The total discount amount for this Service Entry.

discountPercentage.description: The total discount percentage for this Service Entry.

discountType.description: The type of discount applied to this record.

tax1.description: The first tax amount for this Service Entry.

tax1Percentage.description: The first tax percentage for this Service Entry.

tax1Type.description: The type of tax to apply to this record.

tax2.description: The second tax amount for this Service Entry.

tax2Percentage.description: The second tax percentage for this Service Entry.

tax2Type.description: The type of tax to apply to this record.

totalAmount.description: The grand total of this Service Entry.

put.description: Updates an existing vehicle in Fleetio.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

id.description: The Fleetio ID of the relevant Vehicle.  You may also look up Vehicles by their VIN, license plate, or other external ID. See the guide on [External Vehicle Ids](/docs/guides/vehicles/external-vehicle-ids) for information on how to set this up.

fuelTypeId.description: The ID of the `Fuel Type` associated with this Vehicle.

groupHierarchy.description: A pipe delimited group hierarchy. Ex: "Level 1|Level 2|Level 3". Where Level 1 is the parent of Level 2, and 2 is the parent of 3. Any missing nodes in the hierarchy will be created.

labelIds.description: The `label_id`(s) of any Labels to assign to this Vehicle. If you wish to keep any existing Labels, those IDs must be included in this array as well.

licensePlate.description: The license plate number of this Vehicle.

make.description: The name of this Vehicle's manufacturer.

meterUnit.description: The measurement unit used for the Vehicle's primary, or secondary (if applicable), meter.

model.description: The name of the model of this Vehicle.

name.description: A name to assign to this Vehicle. Must be unique.

registrationExpirationMonth.description: The month in which this Vehicle's registration expires.

registrationState.description: The state, province, or territory in which this Vehicle is registered.

secondaryMeter.description: Indicates whether or not this Vehicle has a secondary meter.

secondaryMeterUnit.description: The measurement unit used for the Vehicle's primary, or secondary (if applicable), meter.

trim.description: The trim level of this Vehicle.

vin.description: The Vehicle Identification Number of this Vehicle. Must be unique.

linkedVehicleIds.description: The `vehicle_id`(s) of any Vehicles to link to this Vehicle.

vehicleStatusName.description: The name of the `Vehicle Status` associated with this Vehicle.

vehicleTypeName.description: The name of the `Vehicle Type` associated with this Vehicle.

inServiceDate.description: The date on which this Vehicle was put into service. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

inServiceMeter.description: The meter value at which this Vehicle was put into service.

estimatedServiceMonths.description: The estimated number of months this Vehicle will be in service.

estimatedReplacementMileage.description: The estimated number of miles before which this Vehicle will be replaced.

estimatedResalePrice.description: The estimated resale price of this Vehicle.

outOfServiceDate.description: The date on which this Vehicle was or will be retired. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

outOfServiceMeter.description: The meter value at which this Vehicle was or will be retired.

customFields.description: *Full details on working with Custom Fields [here](/docs/overview/custom-fields).

id.description: The id of the relevant record

name.description: The name of the Vendor. Must be unique.

contactEmail.description: The email address of the contact person for the Vendor.

contactName.description: The name of the contact person for the Vendor.

contactPhone.description: The phone number of the contact person for the Vendor.

externalId.description: An external ID for the Vendor. Must be unique.

phone.description: The phone number of the Vendor.

postalCode.description: The postal code or ZIP code of the Vendor.

region.description: The region, state, province, or territory of the Vendor.

streetAddress.description: The street address of the Vendor.

streetAddressLine2.description: The second line of the street address of the Vendor.

fuel.description: Indicates whether the Vendor provides fuel. Will be able to be listed on `Fuel Entries`.

service.description: Indicates whether the Vendor provides service. This Vendor will be able to be listed on `Service Entries` and `Work Orders`.

parts.description: Indicates whether the Vendor provides parts. This Vendor will be able to be listed on `Parts` and `Purchase Orders`.

vehicle.description: Indicates whether the Vendor provides vehicles. This Vendor will be able to be listed on `Acquisitions` and `Vehicles`.

put.description: Updates an existing work order in Fleetio.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

id.description: The id of the relevant record

issuedAt.description: The date and time at which this Work Order was issued. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

startedAt.description: The date and time at which this Work Order was started. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

completedAt.description: The date and time at which this Work Order was completed. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

invoiceNumber.description: The number of the `Invoice` associated with this Work Order.

vendorName.description: The name of the `Vendor` associated with this Work Order.

vehicleName.description: The name of the `Vehicle` associated with this Work Order.

discountType.description: The type of discount applied to this Work Order.

discount.description: The discount amount in decimal currency units applied to this Work Order.

discountPercentage.description: The percentage of the discount applied to this Work Order. Used if `discount_type` is set to `percentage`.

partsMarkupPercentage.description: The percentage of the parts markup applied to this Work Order. Used if `parts_markup_type` is set to `percentage`.  Note: Parts markup fields are only writiable for Premium tier Fleetio Plan.

partsMarkupType.description: The type of parts markup to apply to this record.  Note: Parts markup fields are only writiable for Premium tier Fleetio Plan.

partsMarkup.description: The amount of the parts markup applied to this Work Order. Used if `parts_markup_type` is set to `fixed`.  Note: Parts markup fields are only writiable for Premium tier Fleetio Plan.

laborMarkupPercentage.description: The percentage of the labor markup applied to this Work Order. Used if `labor_markup_type` is set to `percentage`.  Note: Labor markup fields are only writiable for Premium tier Fleetio Plan.

laborMarkupType.description: The type of labor markup to apply to this record.  Note: Labor markup fields are only writiable for Premium tier Fleetio Plan.

laborMarkup.description: The amount of the labor markup applied to this Work Order. Used if `labor_markup_type` is set to `fixed`.  Note: Labor markup fields are only writiable for Premium tier Fleetio Plan.

tax1Percentage.description: The percentage of the first tax applied to this Work Order. Used if `tax_1_type` is set to `percentage`.

tax1Type.description: The type of tax to apply to this record.

tax1.description: The amount of the first tax applied to this Work Order. Used if `tax_1_type` is set to `amount`.

tax2Percentage.description: The percentage of the second tax applied to this Work Order. Used if `tax_2_type` is set to `percentage`.

tax2Type.description: The type of tax to apply to this record.

tax2.description: The amount of the second tax applied to this Work Order. Used if `tax_2_type` is set to `amount`.

labelList.description: A comma separated list of tags associated with this record. The only delimiter allowed is a comma (`,`). Please remove any commas from your labels before saving the record.

purchaseOrderNumber.description: The number of the `Purchase Order` associated with this Work Order.

description.description: A description of this Work Order.

number.description: The number to be applied to this Work Order. Must be unique.

meterEntryAttributes.description: A Work Order may also be associated with a [Meter Entry](/docs/api/meter-entries).

secondaryMeterEntryAttributes.description: A Work Order may also be associated with a secondary [Meter Entry](/docs/api/meter-entries).

startingMeterEntryAttributes.description: The meter reading at the start of this Work Order.

endingMeterEntryAttributes.description: The meter reading at the end of this Work Order.

startingSecondaryMeterEntryAttributes.description: The secondary meter reading at the start of this Work Order.

endingSecondaryMeterEntryAttributes.description: The secondary meter reading at the end of this Work Order.

customFields.description: *Full details on working with Custom Fields [here](/docs/overview/custom-fields).

endingMeterSameAsStart.description: Use start meter for completion meter?

scheduledAt.description: The date and time at which this Work Order is scheduled. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

expectedCompletedAt.description: The date and time at which this Work Order is expected to be completed. We recommend using [ISO-8601](/docs/overview/date-formatting) formatted dates to avoid ambiguity.

commentsAttributes.description: A list of `Comments` to be added to this Work Order.

workOrderLineItemsAttributes.description: A list of `Work Order Line Items` to be added to this Work Order.

workOrderSubLineItemsAttributes.description: A list of `Work Order Sub Line Items` to be added to this Work Order.

issueIds.description: A list of `Issues` to be added to this Work Order.

labelIds.description: A list of `Labels` to be added to this Work Order.

documentsAttributes.description: An array of one or more document objects to add to the record. Follow our [Attaching Documents and Images](/docs/overview/attaching-documents-and-images) guide to upload to our third party storage provider in order to obtain `file_url`.

imagesAttributes.description: An array of one or more image objects to add to the record. Follow our [Attaching Documents and Images](/docs/overview/attaching-documents-and-images) guide to upload to our third party storage provider in order to obtain `file_url`.
